KeysToEntries.Blight.2.Description:

<Highlight>You gain +10 HP for each tick of damage.</>
KeysToEntries.Blight.3.Description:

You gain +10 HP for each tick of damage.
KeysToEntries.Inspiration.1.Description:
Gain +4 Strength and Intelligence, once per ability hit or basic attack hit. Max 5 stacks.

<Highlight>Nearby minion deaths stores a soul. Hitting an objective or jungle boss fires all of the souls towards the target, dealing 15 damage per soul. Max 30 souls.</>
KeysToEntries.Inspiration.2.Description:
Gain <Highlight>+8</> Strength and Intelligence, once per ability hit or basic attack hit. Max 5 stacks.

Nearby minion deaths stores a soul. Hitting an objective or jungle boss fires all of the souls towards the target, dealing 15 damage per soul. Max 30 souls.
KeysToEntries.Inspiration.3.Description:
Gain +8 Strength and Intelligence, once per ability hit or basic attack hit. Max 5 stacks.

Nearby minion deaths stores a soul. Hitting an objective or jungle boss fires all of the souls towards the target, dealing 15 damage per soul. Max 30 souls.

<Highlight>Gain +1 soul every second.</>
KeysToEntries.Pathfinder.1.Description:
Gain +10% Movement Speed while out of combat.

<Highlight>+5 Tenacity</>
KeysToEntries.Pathfinder.2.Description:
Gain <Highlight>+15%</> Movement Speed while out of combat.

+5 Tenacity
KeysToEntries.Pathfinder.3.Description:
Gain +15% Movement Speed while out of combat.

<Highlight>+10</> Tenacity
KeysToEntries.Primal.1.Description:
Gain +5 Mana Regeneration.

<Highlight>When you take damage from an enemy god, reduce your non-ultimate cooldowns by 1s. Can only occur every 6s.</>
KeysToEntries.Primal.2.Description:
Gain <Highlight>+10</> Mana Regeneration.

When you take damage from an enemy god, reduce your non-ultimate cooldowns by 1s. Can only occur every 6s.
KeysToEntries.Primal.3.Description:
Gain +10 Mana Regeneration.

When you take damage from an enemy god, reduce your non-ultimate cooldowns by 1s. Can only occur every <Highlight>3s</>.
KeysToEntries.Trinkets.1.Description:
Gain a <Highlight>+100</> HP Shield. Stacks with other Trinkets.

Max 900 Shield HP.
KeysToEntries.Trinkets.2.Description:
Gain a <Highlight>+200</> HP Shield. Stacks with other Trinkets. 

Max 900 Shield HP.
KeysToEntries.GoldFury.1.Description: Your speed boost out of fountain is now permanently doubled.
KeysToEntries.GoldFury.2.Description: Nearby friendly minions take reduced damage and deal more damage.
KeysToEntries.GoldFury.3.Description:
Deal +25% bonus true damage to Structures.
Gain +50 Protections when near an enemy Structure.
KeysToEntries.FireGiant.1.Description:
Grants +50 STR or +75 INT.
Regenerates 1% of Health and 0.5% of Mana every second.
KeysToEntries.Warhorn.Friendly.Description:
Your team captured the Warhorn.

Your towers now grant increased movement speed and mana regeneration when standing near them.
KeysToEntries.TowerBounty.Reward.Description:
Enemy Towers drop Bounty rewards when you destroy a segment of their health bar.

The final Bounty grants a lot of Gold, but only one team can get it! Claim the final Bounty first to deny the enemy from getting yours!
KeysToEntries.GoldFury.Reward.Description:
1st Kill: Double Fountain Speed
2nd Kill: Ward Upgrade (Reduced Cooldown, Grants +1 Gold per Reveal)
3rd Kill: Leadership Aura (Buffs nearby Minions)
KeysToEntries.Phoenix.Description: Phoenixes regain health after taking damage, but they cannot regenerate past 50% of their maximum HP.
KeysToEntries.StealthZone.Description: You remain hidden inside patches of foliage until you attack.
KeysToEntries.GoldFury.4.Description: The enemy’s frontmost structures are weakened. Their damage is reduced by 25% and their attack speed is reduced by 50%.
KeysToEntries.Infamy.1.Description:
Defeat Jungle Monsters to gain Infamy with their camp.

Camps with higher levels of Infamy drop more powerful Jungle Buffs.
KeysToEntries.Conquest.Role.Generic.Description:
<Highlight>Slay enemy Gods, minions, and monsters to gain Gold.</> Gold is used to purchase powerful items.

Clear a path into the enemy base by destroying Towers, then <Highlight>slay their Titan to win!</>
KeysToEntries.Conquest.Role.Carry.Description:
You are a <Highlight>damage dealer</>.

Carries typically <Highlight>lane with a Support</>.

<Highlight>Focus on gaining Gold</> by slaying enemy minions and monsters.

Your strength lies in your potential to quickly <Highlight>defeat Bosses and Towers</>.
KeysToEntries.Conquest.Role.Mid.Description:
You are a <Highlight>damage dealer</>.

Mid typically starts in the <Highlight>Middle Lane</>.

<Highlight>Focus on gaining Gold</> by slaying enemy minions and monsters.

Your strength lies in your ability to <Highlight>secure objectives near the center of the map</>.
KeysToEntries.Conquest.Role.Solo.Description:
You are a <Highlight>bruiser and off-tank</>.

Solo typically starts in the <Highlight>Solo Lane</>

<Highlight>Focus on winning your Lane</> by destroying the enemy Tower.

Your strength lies in your ability to <Highlight>damage and disrupt weaker enemies</>.
KeysToEntries.Conquest.Role.Jungle.Description:
You are a <Highlight>roamer and ganker</>.

Jungle typically starts at a <Highlight>Jungle Camp</>.

<Highlight>Focus on gaining Gold</> by slaying Jungle Monsters and enemy Gods.

Your strength lies in your ability to <Highlight>flank and ambush enemies</>.
KeysToEntries.Conquest.Role.Support.Description:
You are a <Highlight>tank and utility support</>.

Support typically starts in <Highlight>lane with a Carry</>.

<Highlight>Focus on helping your teammates</> with their objectives and Gold gain.

Your strength lies in your ability to <Highlight>mitigate damage and disrupt enemies</>.
KeysToEntries.Conquest.Role.Fill.Desciption:
You are a <Highlight>team player</>.

<Highlight>Focus on filling</> into a role your team is missing.
KeysToEntries.Conquest.Role.Generic.ChooseALane.Descri: Pick a lane to start in.
KeysToEntries.Conquest.Lane.Middle.Description:
<Highlight>Destroy the enemy Minions</> when they arrive.

Between Minion waves, you can hunt <Highlight>nearby Monsters in the Jungle</> for extra Gold.
KeysToEntries.Conquest.Lane.Duo.Description:
<Highlight>Destroy the enemy Minions</> when they arrive.

Between Minion waves, you can hunt <Highlight>nearby Monsters in the Jungle</> for extra Gold.
KeysToEntries.Conquest.Lane.Solo.Description:
<Highlight>Destroy the enemy Minions</> when they arrive.

Between Minion waves, you can <Highlight>capture the Warhorn</> to spawn Champion minions for your team.
KeysToEntries.Warhorn.Description: Capture the Warhorn to spawn Champion minions in all 3 lanes.
KeysToEntries.Trinkets.3.Description:
Gain a <Highlight>+300</> HP Shield. Stacks with other Trinkets. 

Max 900 Shield HP.
KeysToEntries.Blight.0.Description: Attacks and abilities apply poison that deals 2.5% of Max Health over 3 seconds.
KeysToEntries.Inspiration.0.Description: Gain +3 Strength and Intelligence, once per ability hit or basic attack hit. Max 5 stacks.
KeysToEntries.Pathfinder.0.Description: Gain +10% Movement Speed while out of combat.
KeysToEntries.Trinkets.0.Description:

Max 900 Shield HP.
KeysToEntries.Naga.0.Description:
Hitting an objective or jungle boss spawns <Highlight>two naga soldiers</> that only attack that target.

Once summoned, they cannot be resummoned again for <Highlight>15s</>.

The Naga soldiers will be unsummoned upon victory or defeat.
KeysToEntries.Practice.PracticeMenu.Description: Open the scoreboard to access the Practice Menu.
KeysToEntries.Gift.0.Description: Grants +5% Strength, Intelligence, and Protections; +1% Max Health Regen for 60s.
KeysToEntries.BattleCry.NoFire:
You don't have any charges for Battle Cry!

You gain charges whenever you defeat a player or when you are defeated.
KeysToEntries.BattleCry.Fire:
You've activated Battle Cry!

Grants +3% Item Stats and 3% Movement Speed per stack consumed.
KeysToEntries.Totem.Description:
The Totem grants Cooldown Reduction to the winner who dealt the most damage to the Totem.

Nearby friendly structures also grant +4 Mana Regeneration.
KeysToEntries.InspirationV2.1.Description:
Gain +3 Strength and Intelligence, once per ability hit or basic attack hit. Max 5 stacks.

<Highlight>Upon reaching max stacks, gain +5% lifesteal.</>
KeysToEntries.InspirationV2.2.Description:
Gain <Highlight>+8</> Strength and Intelligence, once per ability hit or basic attack hit. Max 5 stacks.

Upon reaching max stacks, gain +5% lifesteal.
KeysToEntries.InspirationV2.3.Description:
Gain +8 Strength and Intelligence, once per ability hit or basic attack hit. Max 5 stacks.

<Highlight>Upon reaching max stacks, gain +10% lifesteal.</>
KeysToEntries.Conquest.Teleporter.Description:
Use the Lane Teleporter to quickly return to your furthest Tower.

Lane Teleporters can only be used once every 3 minutes.
KeysToEntries.Conquest.Tower.TargetedByEnemyTower.Desc:
Enemy Towers will attack you if you step into their radius alone.

They will also target you if you hit an enemy God nearby, so watch your aim!
KeysToEntries.Recall.Description:
Receiving damage or taking any action will cancel your Recall.

Look for a safe place to hide before channeling your Recall!
KeysToEntries.Conquest.Hint.Recall.Description:
Receiving damage or taking any action will cancel your Recall.

Look for a safe place to hide before channeling your Recall!
KeysToEntries.Conquest.Hint.ClearingMinionsQuickly:
Focus on slaying the enemy Minions to put pressure on your lane opponent. 

Use abilities to clear Minion waves quickly!
KeysToEntries.Conquest.Hint.AutoBuilder.Description:
Auto Builder will automatically purchase Items for you while in the Fountain.

You can select an Auto Build at the start of a match. In this Tutorial, we've selected one for you.
KeysToEntries.Conquest.ObsidianDagger.AlreadyOwned: You can only hold one Obsidian Dagger in your inventory at a time.
KeysToEntries.CyclopsWard.Description:
A placeable vision ward. Lasts for 120s or until killed. Can carry up to 2 of this item.  

You can have up to two total wards placed in the map.
KeysToEntries.CyclopsWard.AlreadyOwned: You can only hold up to two Cyclops Wards.
KeysToEntries.EyesOfTheJungle.Description: Activate to ping all enemy locations on the minimap once.
KeysToEntries.EyesOfTheJungle.AlreadyOwned: You can only hold up to one of the Eyes of the Jungle.
KeysToEntries.EyesOfTheJungle.SlotsFull: You need at least one empty slot in order to pickup the Eyes of the Jungle.
KeysToEntries.CyclopsWard.SlotsFull: You need at least one empty slot in order to pickup the Cyclops Ward.
KeysToEntries.Primal.Arena.Description: Gain +5 Mana Regeneration and +20 Cooldown Rate
KeysToEntries.CyclopsEye.Description:
Instantly reduces the active cooldown of your Curio by <Highlight>50%</>.

Also heals <Highlight>10%</> of your Health and Mana.
KeysToEntries.Moonlight.Ritual.AlreadyOwned: You can only hold one of each Ritual at a time.
KeysToEntries.FireGiant.2.Description:
Grants +80 STR or +120 INT.
Regenerates 2% of Health and 2% of Mana every second.
KeysToEntries.GoldFury.Reward.StatBuff:
Grants all teammates a permanent Fury Buff:
<highlight>+3% Max Health</>
<highlight>+2% Attack Speed</>
<highlight>+3% Stats From Items</>

+3% Max Health
+2% Attack Speed
+3% all other Stats From Items
